view.scene_description: The image depicts the interior of a large warehouse or storage facility. The space is expansive with high ceilings and concrete floors. There are multiple levels of shelving units on the left side, painted in blue and yellow, filled with various items. In the center of the room, there are several pallets stacked with red crates and cardboard boxes. A few workstations can be seen with chairs and desks. On the right side, there are additional shelves and some equipment. The overall atmosphere suggests an industrial setting, likely used for storage and distribution of goods.

objects.label: Shelving units
objects.observation: Multiple levels of blue and yellow shelving units on the left side, filled with various items. The units have a metal frame and are mounted to the wall. They appear to be used for storing inventory or products. The top level has open shelves while the lower levels have enclosed compartments.

objects.label: Pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets are scattered throughout the room. Some are stacked with red crates and others are empty. The pallets are placed on the concrete floor and support the crates and boxes they carry.

objects.label: Red crates
objects.observation: A stack of red plastic crates is visible in the center of the room. These crates are uniform in size and shape, suggesting they are used for standardized storage and transportation of goods.

objects.label: Cardboard boxes
objects.observation: There are several cardboard boxes scattered around the room. Some are stacked on the pallets while others are placed directly on the floor. The boxes vary in size and shape, indicating they may contain different types of items.

objects.label: Workstations
objects.observation: In the center of the room, there are a few workstations with chairs and desks. These workstations are likely used by employees to manage inventory, process orders, or perform other tasks related to warehouse operations.

objects.label: Equipment
objects.observation: On the right side of the room, there are some pieces of equipment, possibly for lifting or moving heavy items. This equipment includes a forklift and a crane, which are essential tools in a warehouse setting.

prompts.native_user_prompt:
<image>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s3-36397", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}
